name: Starlight of Fylkir - Sublimation
description: A glorious, illusory weapon that emerged from the depths of the Ley Lines, shimmering with the light of "Eternity." It can change its appearance based on the Elemental Type of its wielder. It is said that, in an ancient age beyond all recollection, a divine envoy of the high heavens bestowed the gilded spear upon the high priest of Sal Vindagnyr, granting them the right to lead the city-state before it was buried in silver frost.
